answer: CuriousLLM 的原文明确把自身定位为对 KGP 的增强，而不是 KGP 的训练来源：摘要称其为“an enhancement that integrates a curiosity-driven reasoning mechanism into an LLM agent”[chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]，方法部分说“We introduce CuriousLLM as our graph traversal agent to enhance the KGP framework”[chunk_9f06285c9b321c365675a3b670256a07]，结论也称“CuriousLLM-enhanced KGP framework”把提示重写机制“integrating... into the KG traversal process”并针对“the limitations of the original KGP framework”[chunk_5fc8dbfce1b251b220ab2cf787ef236b]。关于 Follow-upQA，原文只说这是本文提出的新数据集，包含问题与支持证据作为输入、后续问题作为真值[chunk_43145c0748762d6b4c650c65721f826f]，并用于“our model’s training objective”[chunk_9f06285c9b321c365675a3b670256a07]及消融中“fine-tuning on the Follow-upQA dataset”[chunk_f783bd933d0d2a437496939e022a776a]；这些方向都是 CuriousLLM 使用 Follow-upQA 训练自身代理，而非 KGP 以该数据集为训练来源。所给 CuriousLLM 证据中也没有说明 KGP 采用 Follow-upQA 训练。因此按原文方向，不能推出“KGP 以 CuriousLLM 的 Follow-upQA 为训练来源”；但所给证据仅含 CuriousLLM 一篇，缺少另一篇 KGP 原文，无法对 KGP 侧作双向核对，属证据缺口。

Conclusion
Our new CuriousLLM-enhanced KGP framework
represents a significant advance in the field of MD-
QA by integrating an LLM-guided prompt refor-

Curious LLM Traversal Agent
We introduce CuriousLLM as our graph traversal
agent to enhance the KGP framework. This ap-
proach is rooted in intuitive reasoning. For ex-

about Bob’s and Mariaan’s ages are unrelated, or,
in other words, not semantically similar, the follow-
up question about Mariaan’s age creates a logical
link between them. As a result, instead of matching
two unrelated passages, once we find one passage,
we can identify the other through follow-up ques-
tions. Furthermore, we train the LLM agent to
know when to end the search, and this early termi-
nation mechanism significantly reduces the latency
associated with the original T5 agent.
